subject: Chargeback routing and VAT handover for November renewal
messages:
From: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@stellate-health.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Billing Team <billing@stellate-health.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:14:00-05:00
Subject: Renewal — need split invoicing + VAT handling for multiple legal entities

Hi Sean / Monica,

We’re preparing to process the November renewal for Stellate Health (annual subscription). Procurement has asked that invoices be issued per legal entity and that each invoice show the internal cost center allocation for our BU owners. We also need clarity on VAT — Stellate has EU VAT IDs for two entities and will remit locally. Key asks: 

- Can Redwood issue split invoices (one per legal entity) with a cost-center line-level mapping we can ingest?
- Can you confirm which entity will receive payment instructions and whether Redwood will provide VAT-inclusive invoices for the EU entities?
- Are there separate remittance addresses / bank details per Redwood entity, or should we do a single payment with intercompany netting on your side?

Attached: Stellate_renewal_SOW.pdf (for scope) and provisional PO numbers we’ll use. We’re on a tight timeline to close this week — can your billing team propose an approach and a provisional split?

Thanks,
Emma Taylor
Head of Procurement, Stellate Health
emma.taylor@stellate-health.com
Attachment: Stellate_renewal_SOW.pdf (pdf, 230KB)
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@stellate-health.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T13:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — need split invoicing + VAT handling for multiple legal entities

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Quick summary of what we can do and next steps: 

1) We can issue separate invoices per legal entity (Redwood US and Redwood EU) with line-level cost center tags.
2) For EU VAT: we can produce VAT-inclusive invoices for the EU-registered Stellate entities if you supply the VAT registration numbers and the intended billing entity (i.e., which Stellate legal entity should be billed for which portion).
3) Payment routing options:
   - Option A (preferred for Stellate): Stellate pays each Redwood legal entity directly using the bank details we’ll show on each invoice.
   - Option B (single payment): Stellate remits a single consolidated payment to Redwood US and we perform intercompany netting and internal chargebacks. This requires an intercompany settlement run (we can do but it adds 5–7 business days to reconciliation).

I’ve attached a draft split that maps the SOW line items by cost center and proposed invoice recipients — see draft_invoice_split.xlsx. Monica — can your team confirm whether we have separate bank details per legal entity enabled for this customer? Marissa — please advise on the intercompany netting timeline and any walkthrough docs we should share with the customer.

Emma — if you can reply with the Stellate VAT IDs and confirm whether you prefer Option A or B, we’ll generate formal invoices and a DocuSign/portal link for payment.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Attachment: draft_invoice_split.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-26T10:27:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — need split invoicing + VAT handling for multiple legal entities

Thanks Sean — digging in from finance. Notes for the proposed paths: 

- We do have bank details configured per legal entity; Option A is operationally simpler and reduces reconciliation friction for Stellate’s AP.
- If customer chooses Option B (single payment), Finance will perform an internal allocation & intercompany invoice, but note that it will require: intercompany agreement (signed), netting memo, and will push the close by up to one week.
- VAT: we will issue VAT-inclusive invoices for EU legal entities if Stellate provides VAT IDs and the billing address. Please ask them to confirm registered business name exactly as on the VAT cert.

Action items I’ll take:
- I’ll prepare the formal invoice templates for Redwood EU and Redwood US with the cost-center fields populated (showing cost-center codes).
- I’ll include a short guidance sheet on how the line-level chargebacks appear in their ledger (CSV export available).

Monica — I’ll need the final cost center mapping confirmation (from sales) by EOD tomorrow to hit the customer deadline.

-Marissa Cole
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: stellate_vat_certificates.zip (placeholder for their VAT certs if submitted)
From: monica_patel@redwood.com <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@stellate-health.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-28T09:35:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — need split invoicing + VAT handling for multiple legal entities

Hi Emma — following up with the cost-center mapping proposed by the BU leads. We mapped the SOW to three Stellate cost centers: Clinical Ops (CC-101), Platform (CC-202), and Security/Compliance (CC-303). Proposed invoice split: 

- Redwood EU (Invoice EU-2026-779): Clinical Ops + Platform portion (EUR, VAT applied)
- Redwood US (Invoice US-2026-780): Security/Compliance portion (USD, no VAT)

Bank/payment guidance: 
- For Invoice EU-2026-779 pay to: Redwood EU S.A. IBAN: BE12 3456 7890 1234 (details on invoice).
- For Invoice US-2026-780 pay to: Redwood Inc. ACH/Wire details as included.

If Stellate prefers a single consolidated payment we will create an intercompany settlement file post-payment; that requires a signed intercompany memo.

Next steps: 
1) Emma — please confirm the three cost center-to-entity assignments and provide the two VAT registration numbers for the EU entities (exact registered names).
2) Sean — after Emma confirms we’ll push final invoices through the portal and provide separate payment links (DocuSign not required for invoices).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
Attachment: draft_invoice_split.xlsx (updated)

Monica / Sean — thanks, this looks good and aligns with our AP needs. Confirming: 

- Cost center mapping accepted as listed (CC-101, CC-202 to Redwood EU; CC-303 to Redwood US).
- VAT IDs: Stellate Health NV B.V. (EU entity 1): NL123456789B01; Stellate Health Med Ltd. (EU entity 2): BE987654321
- We will pay invoices separately to the two bank accounts (Option A).

Please send the final invoices to billing@stellate-health.com and include the PO numbers in the invoice reference. Once we receive the invoices we’ll schedule payment within our standard 30-day term.

Best,
Emma Taylor
